scope: Order-level asides during cart building and final review: cash change, recipient/gift, urgency, thanks with an open order
auditOfPlannedItem: tryConfirmOrder has no caller outside an incoming turn: public entry points that skip handleIncoming (completeAfterMercadoPagoPayment, sendHumanReply, sendHumanMedia, releaseToBot) never call it, and the turn signature is set at turn start and deleted in finally. Probe of 38 final-step messages (name, same address, same/other payment, cash amounts, access references, notes) created no order without approval («listo» approves by policy). Cash/notes not being part of orderReviewSignature is covered because those routes save through saveForSummaryRefresh (state confirming). No runtime change for this item.
baselineFindings: «traer vueltas de 100 mil» answered «No tengo autorización para comprar vueltas de 100 mil» (off-menu errand)
«tráeme cambio de 50 mil» (accent) was lost silently
«traigan/necesito/llevar cambio de …» and «le pago con un billete de …» stored the leftover verb («traigan», «necesito», «llevar», «con un billete de») as a dish note AND an order note
«es para regalo», «es para mi mamá», «son para mis hijos», «que llegue rápido», «lo más rápido posible» were dropped silently (cart re-shown) in building_cart and awaiting_final_confirm
«es un regalo» answered «Ese plato no está en tu carrito»
«gracias» with an open order answered «Cuando quieras pedir…» as if no order were open
fix: tryHandleOrderLevelAside (early group, after tryHandleLineScopedPaidAddon): standalone cash-change asks set cashChangeFor (normalized «cambio de N»); with a non-cash payment it explains change applies to cash and changes nothing; in awaiting_payment, or «pago con un billete de N» with no payment yet, it defers to the payment route. Recipient/gift and urgency phrases append once to customerNotes; pickup, schedule, address words and catalogue names keep their routes. Final review re-shows the full summary and asks «confirmar». Thanks with a non-empty cart answers that the order is still open plus the step reminder. applyInlineOrderNote no longer falls back to the whole text when only a cash phrase was present, and cash-only leftovers include common verbs.
